relevance_reason: This paper reports a Chinese man with oligoasthenoteratozoospermia who carried compound heterozygous ADGB missense variants. It also includes sperm ultrastructure, protein-loss data and an ICSI outcome, so it directly characterises ADGB-related spermatogenic failure.

findings.statement: Wang et al. (2026) described a Chinese man with primary infertility and severe idiopathic oligoasthenoteratozoospermia. His sperm concentration was 2.0 x 10(6)/mL, progressive motility was below 1%, vitality was 16%, and none of his sperm had normal morphology. He had normal reproductive hormones, a 46,XY karyotype and no Y chromosome microdeletion. Abnormal heads were seen in 76.5% of sperm and abnormal flagella in 62.5%.
quotes: 该患者精液分析提示严重特发性少弱畸精子症（oligoasthenoteratozoospermia, OAT）（浓度：2.0×106 mL－1，前向运动精子比：<1%，正常形态精子比例：0）（表1），生殖内分泌指标正常，染色体核型为46，XY，无Y染色体微缺失。
Abnormal head/% (case) | 76.5 (153/200) |
Abnormal flagella/% (case) | 62.5 (125/200) |

findings.statement: Wang et al. (2026) reported that Papanicolaou staining of the patient's sperm showed head defects, including microcephalic and conical heads. Tail defects were also seen: short tails, acutely angled bent tails, coiled tails and tailless sperm. On transmission electron microscopy, the patient's sperm showed acrosome defects, a disorganized helix of the mitochondrial sheath, and disorganized or missing '9+2' axonemal microtubules.
quotes: 患者精子存在小头、锥形头等头部畸形，以及短尾、锐角弯曲尾、卷尾、无尾等尾部缺陷（图3A）
TEM发现患者精子存在顶体缺陷、线粒体鞘螺旋紊乱及轴丝“9+2”微管紊乱、缺失（图3B）

findings.statement: Wang et al. (2026) performed whole exome sequencing in 781 Chinese men with primary infertility and identified 148 ADGB variants. Under ACMG criteria, 45 were classified as benign, 1 as likely benign, 96 as of uncertain significance and 6 as likely pathogenic. Two of the likely pathogenic missense variants were found in the same patient.
quotes: 781例原发不育中国男性中共鉴定出148个ADGB突变（网络资源附件附表1）。
根据ACMG标准，其中45个突变为良性，1个突变为可能良性，96个突变为意义不确定的变异，6个突变为可能致病性，其中两个可能致病的错义突变来自于同一例患者。

findings.statement: In the man with oligoasthenoteratozoospermia, Wang et al. (2026) identified compound heterozygous ADGB missense variants by whole exome sequencing and confirmed them by Sanger sequencing. One of the two variants was c.4859G>A (p.Arg1620Gln, NM_024694.4). Its frequencies were 0.0010 in 1000 Genomes, 0.0001 in ExAC and 0.00285 in gnomAD. SIFT, PolyPhen-2 and CADD (28.2) predicted it to be damaging, and Arg1620 is absolutely conserved across vertebrates.
quotes: 通过Sanger测序确定该患者为ADGB复合杂合突变（NM_024694.4: c.4859G>A, p.Arg1620Gln; c.4981A>G, p.Lys1661Glu）（图1A）。
其中一个突变c.4859G>A在1000 Genomes、ExAC及gnomAD数据库变异频率分别为0.0010、0.0001和0.00285；另一个突变c.4981A>G分别为0、0和0.0006。
其中Arg1620表现出跨脊椎动物的绝对保守

findings.statement: The second ADGB variant that Wang et al. (2026) found in the same patient was c.4981A>G (p.Lys1661Glu). It was absent from 1000 Genomes and ExAC and had a frequency of 0.0006 in gnomAD. SIFT, PolyPhen-2 (possibly damaging) and CADD (20.4) predicted it to be deleterious. Lys1661 is conserved in mammals but not in birds, amphibians or fish.
quotes: 通过Sanger测序确定该患者为ADGB复合杂合突变（NM_024694.4: c.4859G>A, p.Arg1620Gln; c.4981A>G, p.Lys1661Glu）（图1A）。
Lys1661的保守性呈现显著的类群特异性：哺乳动物中完全保守为赖氨酸，而在鸟类、两栖类和鱼类中则分别被谷氨酰胺、丝氨酸和甘氨酸替代

findings.statement: Wang et al. (2026) found by Western blot that ADGB protein was absent from the patient's sperm. On immunofluorescence, the patient's sperm showed clearly reduced ADGB and reduced PNA (acrosome marker) staining. In control sperm, ADGB was enriched in the acrosome and in the flagellar mitochondrial sheath. AlphaFold3 modeling predicted that the two variants alter the conformation of an alpha-helix and of a C-terminal loop, respectively.
quotes: 同时，Western blot也证实患者精子中ADGB蛋白的表达缺失（图2C）。
通过免疫荧光分析，发现ADGB在正常精子中富集于顶体（PNA共定位）及鞭毛线粒体鞘（α-Tubulin共定位），而该患者的精子中PNA和ADGB表达均明显降低（图2B）。

findings.statement: Wang et al. (2026) used STRING analysis and identified the axoneme assembly proteins TTC29 and CFAP47 as candidate ADGB partners. Co-immunoprecipitation confirmed that both interact with ADGB in sperm. Levels of both proteins were clearly reduced in the patient's sperm. The authors suggested that ADGB may maintain acrosome function and flagellar axoneme assembly by binding TTC29 and CFAP47.
quotes: 本研究通过免疫荧光证实ADGB缺陷患者精子中TTC29和CFAP47蛋白水平较对照组明显降低（图6A）。
同时，通过免疫共沉淀进一步验证了TTC29和CFAP47与ADGB在精子中存在相互作用（图6B）。这些发现提示ADGB可能通过结合TTC29和CFAP47，从而维持顶体的功能和鞭毛轴丝的正常组装。

findings.statement: Wang et al. (2026) found that ADGB expression in human testis is low before puberty and peaks in adulthood. In both human and mouse spermatogenic cells, ADGB localized to the acrosome and the flagellum. In mice, Adgb mRNA was highly expressed in adult testis, expressed at low levels in lung and ovary, and peaked in testis at postnatal day 40.
quotes: 青春期前维持低水平，青春期后逐渐升高并在成年期达到表达峰值（附图1A）
Adgb mRNA在成年小鼠睾丸中特异性高表达，在肺和卵巢中低表达，而在其他器官（膀胱、附睾、大肠、心、脾、肾、肝、胃和脑）中几乎不表达（图5A）
免疫荧光实验证实ADGB在小鼠精子发生过程中同样定位于顶体和鞭毛，且其表达模式与人类高度一致（图5C）

findings.statement: Wang et al. (2026) reported that the patient's partner conceived with ICSI. 36 oocytes were retrieved and the normal 2PN fertilization rate was 70%. Transfer of a single frozen-thawed blastocyst led to a full-term delivery. The authors noted that all 5 reported couples with ADGB variants had achieved clinical pregnancy with ICSI.
quotes: 在首次ICSI治疗周期中，该患者的伴侣共获卵36枚。受精后18 h评估显示正常双原核受精率为70%，未发生多精受精现象。
首次冻融周期内，移植1枚4BA评分囊胚后，超声检测到胎心搏动，目前已足月分娩
目前报道的5例ADGB基因突变不孕夫妇均通过ICSI技术实现临床妊娠

relevance_reason: Reports biallelic ADGB variants in infertile men with asthenoteratozoospermia, which establishes the SPGF105 phenotype.

findings.statement: Gao et al. (2025) described 3 unrelated infertile Han Chinese men with severe asthenoteratozoospermia. Under light and electron microscopy, their spermatozoa showed multiple malformations of the acrosome and flagellum.
quotes: samples from three unrelated infertile men with severe asthenoteratozoospermia from Han Chinese families
the spermatozoa from patients harboring ADGB variants showed multiple acrosome and flagellum malformations under light and electron microscopy

findings.statement: Gao et al. (2025) performed whole-exome sequencing in a cohort of 105 Han Chinese men with idiopathic asthenoteratozoospermia. In 1 infertile man they identified a homozygous frameshift variant in the ADGB gene (c.2801_2802del, p.K934Rfs*33; NM_024694.4), confirmed by Sanger sequencing. The variant was rare in the general population and was predicted to be damaging by multiple bioinformatics tools.
quotes: in a cohort of 105 Han Chinese men with idiopathic asthenoteratozoospermia, we reported the identification of bi-allelic deleterious variants of ADGB in three infertile men from unrelated families using whole-exome sequencing
We found one homozygous frameshift ADGB variant (NM_024694.4: c.2801_2802del:p.K934Rfs*33)
These variants were rare in general population and were predicted to be damaging by multiple bioinformatics tools.

findings.statement: In 1 infertile Han Chinese man with asthenoteratozoospermia, Gao et al. (2025) identified a homozygous missense variant in the ADGB gene (c.C3167T, p.T1056I; NM_024694.4). The variant was rare in the general population and was predicted to be damaging.
quotes: one homozygous missense ADGB variant (NM_024694.4: c.C3167T:p.T1056I)
These variants were rare in general population and were predicted to be damaging by multiple bioinformatics tools.

findings.statement: In 1 infertile Han Chinese man with asthenoteratozoospermia, Gao et al. (2025) identified compound heterozygous missense variants in the ADGB gene (c.C3167T, p.T1056I and c.C3197T, p.A1066V; NM_024694.4). The variants were rare in the general population and were predicted to be damaging.
quotes: one compound heterozygous ADGB variant (NM_024694.4: c.C3167T:p.T1056I; c.C3197T:p.A1066V)

findings.statement: In sperm from the patients, Gao et al. (2025) found through functional assays that the structural defects were associated with dysregulation of ADGB and of multiple spermatogenesis proteins. PLC-zeta was expressed normally, but calmodulin (CaM) was deficient.
quotes: Functional assays revealed the structural defects associated with dysregulation of ADGB and multiple spermatogenesis proteins.
as well as the normal expression of PLCζ but CaM deficiency in the spermatozoa

findings.statement: Gao et al. (2025) reported that intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) led to successful fertilization in all 3 patients. Together with the CaM deficiency in the sperm, this suggested to the authors that ICSI rather than in vitro fertilization is the best treatment for ADGB-deficient patients.
quotes: Notably, the fertilization success via ICSI treatment in all three patients, as well as the normal expression of PLCζ but CaM deficiency in the spermatozoa, suggesting that ICSI other than in vitro fertilization (IVF) is an optimal treatment for ADGB-deficient patients.

findings.statement: Gao et al. (2025) noted that knockout of Adgb in male mice had previously been reported to cause male infertility, with spermatogenesis defects involving the flagella and acrosome.
quotes: In male mice, adgb-knockout has been reported to cause male infertility with spermatogenesis defects involving flagella and acrosome.

relevance_reason: Reports ADGB variants in an infertile man with asthenozoospermia, with functional and mouse model support; this defines SPGF105.

findings.statement: Qu et al. (2023) described an infertile male with asthenozoospermia.
quotes: Variants in the androglobin (ADGB) gene were identified in an infertile male characterized by asthenozoospermia.

findings.statement: Qu et al. (2023) identified variants in the ADGB gene in an infertile man with asthenozoospermia. The variants disrupted the binding of ADGB to calmodulin.
quotes: Variants in the androglobin (ADGB) gene were identified in an infertile male characterized by asthenozoospermia.
The variants disrupted the binding of ADGB to calmodulin.

findings.statement: Qu et al. (2023) found that male Adgb -/- mice were infertile because of reduced sperm concentration (less than 1 x 10(6)/mL) and reduced sperm motility. Spermatogenesis was abnormal, with malformed elongating and elongated spermatids, and the cauda epididymis had about twice as many apoptotic cells. ICSI with testicular spermatids led to fertilization and development to the blastocyst stage.
quotes: Adgb-/- male mice were infertile due to reduced sperm concentration (< 1 × 106 /mL) and motility.
Spermatogenesis was also abnormal, with malformation of both elongating and elongated spermatids, and there was an approximately twofold increase in apoptotic cells in the cauda epididymis.
It is surprising that ICSI with testicular spermatids allows fertilization and eventually develops into blastocyst.

findings.statement: Using mass spectrometry, Qu et al. (2023) identified 42 candidate proteins that interact with ADGB and are involved in sperm assembly, flagella formation, and sperm motility. They confirmed that CFAP69 and SPEF2 bind to ADGB.
quotes: Through mass spectrometry, we identified 42 candidate proteins that are involved in sperm assembly, flagella formation, and sperm motility interacting with ADGB.
In particular, CFAP69 and SPEF2 were confirmed to bind to ADGB.
